description:
Top Three Skills 
 SSRS,
 reports,
 SQL 
 Job Description: 
 The Reports Developer is responsible for creating SSRS reports based on business requirements and specifications. This person must be efficient at reading and writing SQL and understanding basic SQL structure (i.e. queries, tables, views, etc). 

Envision is migrating from Salesforce to MS Dynamics. This reports developer will be responsible for pulling information from Salesforce to create reports for the new CRM. They have successfully migrated 3 of their 12 primary applications over to MS Dynamics. 
 
 Work Environment: 
 Agile Kanban, team-oriented environment 
 Interview Information: 
 phone interview with manager than face-to-face. 
 Who is the Internal/External Customer 
 EmCare 
 Business Challenge: 
 Envision is in the process implementing and enterprise-wide CRM migration from Salesforce to MS Dynamics. 
 Non-Technical Skills: 
 Passionate and good attitude. 
 Why is position open? 
 Support of CRM migration 
 Project Stage/Lifecycle Info 
 Technical Environment: 
 MS Dynamics, .Net 
  

 
 6 month contract
